industry.zh: 薪资、人事与员工福利软件

tagline.zh: 面向中小企业的薪酬与人员管理平台。
tagline.en: Payroll and people management for small businesses.

overview.zh: Gusto 前身为 ZenPayroll，创立于 2011 年，为美国中小企业提供薪酬计算、税务申报支持和人事管理工具。
overview.en: Gusto began as ZenPayroll in 2011 and builds payroll, tax-filing support and HR tools for US small businesses.

overview.zh: 公司后来将福利、员工入职、考勤等功能整合到平台之中。具体服务因美国地区与企业条件不同而有所差异。
overview.en: It subsequently integrated benefits, employee onboarding, time tracking and other people-operations capabilities; availability varies by jurisdiction and employer.

overview.zh: Deepgram 创立于 2015 年，专注语音人工智能，最初研发深度学习语音识别，后来拓展到文本转语音及语音交互技术。
overview.en: Founded in 2015, Deepgram develops voice AI, beginning with deep learning speech recognition and expanding into speech synthesis and voice interactions.

overview.zh: 其平台服务呼叫中心、实时字幕、语音助手及开发者应用，提供转录、音频理解与对话式语音接口。
overview.en: The platform serves contact centers, live transcription, voice agents and developer applications with transcription, audio intelligence and conversational voice APIs.

overview.en: Founded in 2017, ClickUp develops an integrated work-management platform for teams and individuals to organize tasks, projects and progress.

overview.zh: 除任务管理外，ClickUp 还提供文档、目标、仪表盘和 AI 辅助工具，以支持跨部门协作。

tagline.en: Tools for planning, interviewing and hiring talent.

overview.zh: Greenhouse 是一家美国招聘技术企业，提供申请人追踪系统（ATS）和结构化招聘工具，帮助招聘团队管理岗位、面试与候选人流程。
overview.en: Greenhouse is a US hiring technology company providing an applicant tracking system and structured hiring workflows to manage jobs, interviews and applicants.

overview.zh: 其公开 Job Board 产品还被多家企业用作官方岗位展示来源；HHBA 引用的是各企业公开岗位，不代表 Greenhouse 或雇主授权合作。
overview.en: Its public Job Board software is used by employers to publish roles; HHBA uses public postings without implying that Greenhouse or an employer has authorized a partnership.

description.en: Applicant tracking from requisition to offer

overview.zh: Binance 是 2017 年推出的数字资产交易平台与区块链生态系统。其官方介绍涵盖数字资产交易、研究、教育以及与区块链相关的产品和服务。
overview.en: Launched in 2017, Binance is a digital-asset exchange and blockchain ecosystem. Its official materials describe trading services, research, education and other blockchain-related offerings.

overview.zh: Binance 的业务覆盖多个法律实体和司法辖区，并非所有服务在所有国家可用。HHBA 仅独立整理公司背景及招聘来源，不提供加密资产投资建议，亦不将 Binance 与 HHBA 描述为合作招聘关系。
overview.en: Binance services operate across legal entities and jurisdictions, and product access varies by location. HHBA independently describes the business and its recruiting source, without investment advice or any implied hiring partnership.

overview.en: Founded in 2015, Airwallex is a financial technology company originating in Australia that provides international payments, foreign exchange and related infrastructure to businesses.

overview.zh: Airwallex 的产品覆盖企业账户、全球付款、嵌入式支付和费用管理，服务范围依赖不同地区的监管与牌照。
overview.en: Its products include business accounts, global transfers, embedded payments and spend management. Coverage and permissions depend on local licensing and regulation.

overview.zh: Harvey 是一家美国人工智能软件企业，向律师事务所、企业法务和专业服务机构提供用于知识工作和文档处理的 AI 工具。
overview.en: Harvey is a US AI software company serving law firms, in-house legal teams and professional services with tools for knowledge work and document processing.

overview.zh: 其官方产品介绍涉及合同分析、尽职调查、合规及诉讼相关工作流。AI 生成结果需要专业人员复核，招聘岗位职责应以官方 JD 为准。
overview.en: Its published use cases include contract review, due diligence, compliance and litigation workflows. AI outputs require professional review; role qualifications come from official job descriptions.

overview.en: Flexport is a US logistics and supply-chain technology company offering freight forwarding, shipment coordination, customs services and visibility for cross-border trade.

overview.zh: 其平台连接海运、空运、仓储和物流数据，帮助客户了解运输状态与成本。招聘涵盖运营、报关合规、软件及全球客户服务。
overview.en: Its platform coordinates ocean and air freight, warehousing and logistics data so customers can track movement and costs. Roles span operations, customs compliance, software and customer support.

overview.zh: Form Energy 是 2017 年创立的美国能源技术企业，致力于通过低成本长时储能支持电网稳定运行，其核心技术方向是可充放电的铁空气电池系统。
overview.en: Founded in 2017, Form Energy is a US energy technology company developing cost-oriented long-duration grid storage using rechargeable iron-air battery systems.

overview.zh: 公司的研发包括电池化学、电化学系统、量产制造和电网项目交付。官方资料记录了从实验室原型到工厂和示范项目的发展。
overview.en: Its work spans battery chemistry, electrochemical systems, manufacturing scale-up and grid projects. Official histories cover progress from prototypes to factories and demonstrations.

overview.en: Ramp is a US financial technology company offering corporate cards, expense reimbursement, purchasing approvals and spend controls to organizations.

overview.zh: Twilio 产品覆盖短信、电话、身份验证及客户数据和互动工具。公司提供的软件基础设施面向开发者和企业运营团队。
